source_policy_decisions.decision: Pair the operands in order. A ripening of an ear or a fruit root on the same ordered input is excluded. No new marker from the voiced joined spelling.
Carry only the root or beginning at 25. Register two attested calendrical cases within the ordinary feminine paradigm.
External feminine singular, internal locative dual and the lunar time adverbial have distinct operands. The internal dual is attested in the commentary.
Separate the wing root, rib at the root of the right side, and first lunar day. Record the next rib separately. Keep both recensional deity sequences.
Four singular positions have two licensed readings. Direct textual support for pakṣatau does not imply that its alternate occurs in the stanza.
